newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice drops on lower cash markets.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice drops on lower cash markets.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on lower cash markets in Asia and the United States, traders said.
"It appears all the Asian makets are looking for buyers," a trader said. "There is not enough business to support the $440.00 per tonne U.S. market."
LIT America sold the market early and fund selling was noted in late dealings. Traders also pointed to fairly active selling of calls in the rice options pit.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 650 contracts, up from 410 Wednesday.
Rice futures closed 17 to 20-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with November down 20-1/2 at $9.79 per cwt.
